Pune, India
sumit.paul11@yahoo.com |+91 8446002677

Lead Business Analyst | Banking, Wealth Management & Insurance
Agile | Jira | Azure DevOps | Salesforce | Guidewire | RPA

Professional Summary

Experienced in Business Process Transformation, Target Operating Model (TOM), Business Capability Mapping, Process Architecture, Customer Journey Mapping, and Future-State Operating Model Design across Global Banking and Wealth Management platforms. Proven ability to translate business strategy into scalable operating models, business capabilities, and technology solutions while collaborating with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Technology teams.

Key Skills

Business Analysis & Delivery

Business Analysis, Requirement Elicitation, Stakeholder Management

BRD, FRD, Use Cases, Gap Analysis, RTM

Process Mapping, As-Is / To-Be, Change Management

Agile & Ways of Working

Agile, Scrum, SAFe, PI Planning

User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Backlog Refinement

Prioritization (MoSCoW, WSJF)

Domains

Banking & Payments (Wealth Management, KYC/AML, DXP)

Insurance (P&C, Claims, Motor, Subrogation, Underwriting)

RPO / HR Systems

Platforms & Tools

Salesforce, Guidewire, RPA (Blue Prism), Actimize (NICE Actimize)

Appian, Pega, Creatio CRM

Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Mural, Balsamiq, Figma

Data & Reporting

SQL, Data Analysis & Validation

Tableau, Power BI, MS Excel

Key Projects

BACS Recall Automation (QMS) – Barclays – End to end automation through Pega SI

Wealth Digital Experience Platform (Wealth Management) – HSBC - Enhancing digital onboarding, portfolio visibility, and advisory workflows for affluent and HNI clients

Dynamic Experience Platform – HSBC

Insurance Platforms – Allstate (US): Salesforce-based delivery across Property & Casualty Insurance, Claims, Motor Claims, and Subrogation

KYC/AML – Onboarding and Transactional Monitoring Automation through Actimize (NICE ACTIMIZE)

Certifications

Certified Business Analyst – Mind Map Solutions

Certified Appian Analyst (ACA100) – Appian

Certified Creatio CRM Administrator

Certified Product Owner – HSBC

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt – KPMG

Professional Experience

Bits in Glass Pvt. Ltd, Pune (Client - Barclays)

Lead Business Analyst | Dec 2024 – Present

Working with Barclays in QMS BACS recall automation

Conducting stakeholder analysis by identifying stakeholders’ roles, responsibilities, and level of influence in the project.

Delivered business transformation initiatives by improving customer journeys, simplifying business processes, strengthening governance controls, and supporting scalable operating model design across global banking platforms

Understanding business goals, objectives, and perspectives from stakeholders.

Managing, engaging, and partnering with stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate functional and non-functional requirements.

Validating, verifying, and obtaining sign-off on requirements documentation.

Defining data elements, fields, formats, and validation rules by creating data dictionaries.

Managing backlog using Jira, and facilitating refinement, sprint planning, and reviews.

Collaborating with architects and developers to analyze feasibility and delivery effort.

Leading QA coordination and ensuring high-quality deliverables aligned to user expectations.

Setting up sprint planning and sprint refinement sessions and coordinating with multiple PODs.

Presenting internal and external demos to business and technology teams.

Taking complete ownership of the project from requirements gathering through development, testing, and implementation.

Supported Operating Model Transformation initiatives by redesigning payment operations, governance controls, approval workflows, and business processes for BACS Recall automation.

Conducted Business Capability Assessments to identify process improvement opportunities, automation initiatives, and capability enhancements across payment operations.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops to validate future-state operating models, business capabilities, process changes, and transformation priorities.

Produced executive-level process documentation including capability maps, process architecture, future-state workflows, and operating model recommendations.

Supporting UAT, reviewing test cases, and ensuring requirement clarity for testers.

Teksystems - Allegis Global (Client: HSBC Bank)

Lead Business Analyst – Digital Experience Platform | Mar 2023 – Nov 2024

Worked with HSBC bank in Wealth Management and DXP Project

Performed stakeholder identification and analysis

Defined and streamlined the requirement front-door process with Product Managers and Product Owners

Gathered and documented regulatory, security, and compliance requirements across regions

Prioritized product and sprint backlogs using MoSCoW, WSJF, and stakeholder feedback

Created process maps for online policy purchase, premium payment workflows, and document download processes

Supported digital transformation across Wealth Management platforms by improving onboarding workflows, reducing manual touchpoints, and enhancing customer experience through process optimization and Agile delivery

Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) activities by documenting future-state business processes, governance workflows, and operating procedures for Digital Experience Platform initiatives.

Worked with Product, UX, and business stakeholders to analyse digital customer journeys and identify opportunities to improve onboarding and servicing experiences.

Supported business capability assessment by identifying process dependencies, functional ownership, and opportunities for process improvement across Wealth Management workflows.

Developed end-to-end process flows and future-state business workflows supporting digital transformation initiatives.

Collaborated with Enterprise Architecture and Technology teams to ensure business requirements aligned with future-state solution design and enterprise standards.

Facilitated demos, sprint ceremonies, and weekly dashboards for UK, US, and Canada teams

Written detailed user stories and use cases capturing specific functionalities and multiple scenarios

Worked closely with developers to clarify requirements and provide feedback during development

Performed data analysis, modelling, validation, and categorization using SQL

Collaborated with developers, tech leads, and architects to design solutions aligned with business requirements

Led delivery of HSBC’s Dynamic Experience Platform including content hosting, URL migration, and AWS cloud onboarding

Enabled onboarding of 8+ markets with improvement in content delivery speed.

Identified inefficiencies and proposed improvements to enhance user experience and operational efficiency

Assisted PMs and leads with scope definition, estimation, timelines, and stakeholder management

Allstate Solutions Pvt. Ltd, Pune

Business Analyst – Insurance Domain | Aug 2015 – Jan 2023

Led multiple projects across Property & Casualty Insurance, Claims, Motor Claims, and Subrogation domains integrating RPA solutions and Guidewire Platforms

Worked extensively on Salesforce and Salesforce Experience Cloud implementations.

Enabled reduction in claims turnaround time by driving automation initiatives across claims and subrogation workflows

Created detailed process flows, user stories, and regulatory-compliant documentation.

Acted as liaison between underwriters, claims adjusters, policy administrators, and development teams

Analyzed insurance processes including policy issuance, underwriting, claims processing, and renewals.

Identified opportunities for process improvement and automation.

Provided expertise on insurance regulations, ACORD standards, and industry best practices.

Supported SIT, UAT, defect triage, and post-production stabilization.

Guided developers through requirement walkthroughs and prioritization.

Owned delivery end to end from requirements through implementation.

ADP India Pvt. Ltd

Sr. Project Associate (Business Analyst) – RPO | Dec 2013 – Aug 2015

Worked in Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) domain, supporting automation of recruitment and workforce management processes.

Led requirement gathering and analysis for job posting automation, enabling automated publishing of job requisitions across multiple job portals and internal systems.

Defined business and functional requirements for interview scheduling automation, streamlining interviewer availability, candidate notifications, and schedule confirmations.

Worked on medical appointment automation workflows as part of employee onboarding and compliance processes.

Elicited and documented BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows for recruitment and onboarding automation initiatives.

Collaborated closely with recruiters, HR operations, and IT teams to understand recruitment pain points and translate them into system-driven solutions.

Worked with developers and SMEs to clarify requirements, dependencies, and edge cases.

Tech Mahindra Pvt. Ltd

Junior Analyst | Jul 2007 – May 2012

Supported requirement gathering, documentation, and testing activities.

Authored BRDs, user stories, and test cases.

Acted as liaison between development, testing, and regulatory teams.

Conducted interviews, workshops, and surveys for requirement elicitation.

Tools & Technologies

Jira | Confluence | Azure DevOps | Guidewire | RPA (Blue Prism) | Actimize (NICE Actimise) | Appian | Pega | Salesforce | Mural | MS Visio | Excel | SQL | Balsamiq | Figma (Basic)

Education

2007 - Bachelor of Commerce – RDVV Jabalpur University, India
2004 - 12th – St. Aloysius Senior Secondary School (CBSE)
2002 - 10th – St. Aloysius Senior Secondary School (CBSE)
